name: vassole-smart-player-iptv
description: Vassole Smart Player IPTV: player de IPTV para listas M3U e contas Xtream Codes, sem ativação.

scripts.test: node test/unit.mjs && node test/lang.mjs && node test/subs.mjs && node test/proxy.mjs && node test/polyfills.mjs && node test/build.mjs && node scripts/build-sw.mjs --check
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/build.mjs android && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
